text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm starting a short RFC for how SLO alerts are surfaced in the console. Main goal: reduce noisy fanout for low-severity breaches while keeping criticals immediate. Want API/UX/telemetry alignment.

andrew-b: High level agree. We need a firm contract for alert -> console mapping (severity, impacted_entities, fingerprint). Without that UI can't dedupe or batch.

jay: Can we reuse existing alert labels/annotations instead of adding lots of new fields? We already set manifest.tags in some pipelines.

sarah: alerts-bot currently tags `slo=true` but doesn't include window or objective id. That causes a lot of near-duplicate alerts when windows slide.

liz_devex: UX constraints: console should surface a recommended notify channel (pager/email/owner) but always allow one-click override. Also show confidence and a sample of recent traces.

maya: Proposed minimal schema snippet (for discussion):

```json
{
  "alert_id": "string",
  "fingerprint": "string",
  "service": "string",
  "tenant_id": "string",
  "slo_objective": "string",
  "window_start": "iso8601",
  "window_end": "iso8601",
  "breach_type": "eg. threshold/latency_exceed",
  "severity": "1|2|3",
  "tags": ["string"],
  "notify_hint": ["pager","email","owner"],
  "trace_link": "optional string"
}
```

maya: Note: the file above is just a proposal. We can compress fields into tags if we prefer, but the UI benefits from explicit fields.

andrew-b: Implementation concerns: fanout reduction requires both sampling and dedupe. Suggest policy: sev==1 immediate fanout; sev==2 batch per-tenant with 5m coalesce window; sev==3 rollup/digest. Need a delivery_id to ensure idempotent deliveries.

maya: Agreed on policy. Edge rule: if sev==2 and any linked traces indicate a regression (confidence>0.8) then escalate to immediate.

jay: UI consolidation: when a tenant has breaches across multiple objectives, merge into single notification with per-objective rows and quick links. That should cut noise.

andrew-b: API change: emit `notify_hint` + `delivery_id` (optional but recommended) and keep fingerprint + window_start as core dedupe key. Also maintain raw events for 90d so we can re-run analyses.

sarah: Telemetry: add `alert_event_id` and ensure any attached trace ids are passed through. If trace missing, console must show "no trace collected" rather than failing to render. Also we should tag events with ingest-shard to trace fanout cost later.

liz_devex: Rollout plan (proposal): feature-flag the console mapping per-tenant. Phase 1: internal orgs only (dev/test). Phase 2: invited beta customers. Phase 3: default-on with opt-out. Track missed-criticals and fanout rate.

andrew-b: I'll own the simulation/eval: generate 1000 tenants, include one noisy tenant (100 breaches/hr) and measure fanout delta and time-to-alert for sev1 vs sev2. Want automation before merge.

jay: I'll prototype the merged notification UI (quick wireframe here: https://figma/redwood/slo-merge-proto).

sarah: small nit — retention policy: preserve raw alert events for 90d, indexed for replays.

alerts-bot: deploy status: schema PR opened -> https://git/repo/PR-1423 :eyes:

maya: Ok. Next steps: 1) spec PR (I'll draft) 2) API emit changes (eng-api) 3) console mapping + batching 4) feature flag + telemetry. Target: 3 sprints for full rollout if owners ok.

andrew-b: +1 from me. I'll add the simulation playbook to the PR.

liz_devex: I'll draft the UX toggles and message templates.

maya: Thanks everyone — will sync briefly after standup. @andrew-b @liz_devex please pick owners for telemetry and rollout on the PR. :thumbsup:
